card.name: Last digit of a number before mg
card.fires_on: The final digit or character of a number just before a unit, arrow, or mapping symbol, such as the last 0 in 300 mg or the % in 37%. It appears in dose and drug-interaction tables and in number-conversion lists.

modes.label: Dose number ending
modes.description: Last digit of a dose amount right before mg.
modes.example: Dose reduction of rifabutin by at least 75% of the usual dose (30<<0>> mg once daily) is recommended

modes.label: Interaction change figures
modes.description: Percent sign or number in an AUC or Cmax change next to an arrow.
modes.example: 37% ↓ in AUC, 37<<%>> ↓ in C max and 35

modes.label: Number conversion lists
modes.description: Digit in a number base example just before a mapping arrow.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict an arrow symbol such as → or => next.
card.plain: It marks the end of a number where an arrow or a unit is likely to come next.
